name: Unit pipeline
summary: Minimal generic planning template for any project or domain.

phases.label: Plan
phases.exit: Goal, scope, and initial tasks are defined.

phases.label: Execute
phases.exit: All planned tasks and acceptance checks are complete.

phases.label: Review
phases.exit: Final outcomes and evidence are verified and recorded.

granularity.rule: Each microtask must state a single verifiable outcome.

memory_sections.label: Goal
memory_sections.hint: State the main objective and definition of done.

memory_sections.label: Decisions
memory_sections.hint: Log key choices made and the reasons behind them.

memory_sections.label: Constraints
memory_sections.hint: List deadlines, limits, and non-negotiable rules.
